To disable the dual-screen presenter console in LibreOffice Impress and use only one monitor for presentations, follow these steps:

1. Open the **Tools** menu from the top menu bar
2. Select **Options...** (or press Alt+F12)
3. In the Options dialog, expand **LibreOffice Impress** in the left tree
4. Click on **General** under LibreOffice Impress
5. In the right panel, under the **Presentation** section, **uncheck** the **Enable Presenter Console** checkbox
6. Click **OK** to save the changes

This setting is now disabled, so whenever you start a presentation, it will display only on one monitor showing the actual presentation slides. The second monitor will no longer show the presenter console with current slide, next slide, and other presenter information, allowing you to use it for other purposes during your presentation.

The change has been saved and will apply to all future presentations in LibreOffice Impress.
